decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed extension, which creates a total volume increase of 51.3 cubic metres and includes:
?	A new extended side infill extension, with a height of 3.225m, width of 1.65m and depth of 6.8m that adds a volume of 36.18 cubic metres;
?	Rear mansard roof extension with a height of 2.15m, width of 5.2m and depth of 2.35m, that adds a volume of 13.14 cubic metres; and
?	Large dormer window with a height of 1.35m, width of 2.45m and depth of 0.7m that has a volume of 1.16 cubic metres; and
?	Smaller dormer window with a height of 1.35m, width of 1.75m and depth of 0.7m that has a volume of 0.83 cubic metres,
as shown on drawing numbers 5014/01 to 5014/10 dated November 2002 and received by Council 27 November 2002, is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission.

Certificate of Lawfulness be GRANTED.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of existing side infill extension, erection of a new extended side infill extension, alteration of roof extension, erection of single storey rear extension and erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
